events.event_name: Mary Kay ‘Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared’ Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A public Mary Kay beauty activation at Gansevoort Plaza with an oversized vanity experience, beauty touch-ups, product giveaways and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise free full-size Mary Kay makeup and skincare products; Mary Kay's Eventbrite listing advertises 10,000 products to give away.
events.caveats: Multiple current sources agree on Tuesday, September 15, noon–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza and describe the activation as free/open to the public. A live Eventbrite listing organized by Mary Kay U.S. exists, but public-event sources do not establish that registration is mandatory, so RSVP is treated as optional rather than required.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15, 12–7 PM. Free public beauty activation; optional Eventbrite registration is available. Giveaway inventory may be supply-limited.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A branded eos and NYLON truck introducing Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments on the final day of NYFW.
events.what_is_free: Product sampling and sweet treats are advertised at the public pop-up; quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: NYC for FREE and Average Socialite independently agree on Tuesday, September 15, noon–5 PM at 575 Broadway and describe it as open to the public. No advance RSVP requirement is published in the sources reviewed.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15, 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway. Walk-in public truck activation; samples and treats may be supply-limited.

events.address: Century 21 NYC, 22 Cortlandt St, New York, NY 10007
events.what_it_is: Century 21 opens a runway on its main floor for anyone to walk during the closing days of NYFW, with staff filming participants for the store's social stories.
events.what_is_free: Century 21's official event page says each walker receives a free tote, up to five iron-on patches and a $21-off-$100 in-store card; totes and patches are while supplies last.
events.caveats: Century 21's current official page explicitly says there is no ticket, invitation, registration or online sign-up. The runway runs September 15 and 16 from noon–6 PM both days. Participation involves being filmed for Century 21 social stories. Totes and patches are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: September 15 and 16, 12–6 PM each day. Enter the main floor from the Dey Street side and get in line; no RSVP or ticket is required.

events.event_name: Hempz × Ulta Beauty Serene Waters Pop-Up
events.address: Ulta Beauty Herald Square, 51 W 34th St, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A Hempz pop-up outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square centered on the Serene Waters with Magnesium body-care collection, with a calm-down experience and product discovery.
events.what_is_free: Current event listings advertise free magnesium iced teas from Drink Wild Wonder plus additional surprises; promotional quantities may be limited.
events.caveats: Current NYC event calendars agree on Tuesday, September 15, 12:30–6:30 PM outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square and describe the activation as open to the public. No advance RSVP requirement is published in the sources reviewed. No first-party event page was located in this pass.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15, 12:30–6:30 PM outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square. Walk-in public activation; giveaways may be supply-limited.

events.address: Participating Insomnia Cookies bakeries in New York City
events.what_it_is: Insomnia Cookies' annual PJ Party, with the core giveaway running at every U.S. and Canada bakery and expanded experiences at selected campus stores.
events.what_is_free: Guests who arrive in pajamas can receive one free Classic cookie in-store with no purchase or Rewards membership required; giveaways are while supplies last.
events.caveats: Insomnia's current announcement says the free Classic cookie is available September 15 in-store at every U.S. and Canada bakery to guests wearing pajamas, with no purchase or Rewards membership required. NYC event listings place the PJ Party window at 8 PM–close; local bakery closing times vary, so visitors should check the selected store before traveling.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 beginning around 8 PM at NYC Insomnia Cookies bakeries. Wear pajamas and claim the free Classic cookie in-store; check the chosen bakery's closing time.
